blocks.title: Why this skill exists
blocks.content: Remotion's components and props keep evolving (for example @remotion/media). This domain knowledge is consulted before reaching for an API, which keeps the generated code off outdated usage.

## When to use

Whenever you write or edit Remotion code: scaffolding a video project, sequencing scenes and transitions, captions and animation, dynamic duration, and rendering.
